description: Full-cycle gate walk on a throwaway copy of the live pilot track (real track untouched; HARNESS_ROOT retargets a fixture root): baseline-red, green, mutant-red, restore-green, report-bound. Catches cross-leg harness/track drift no static case covers.
executor_contract: {"cwd": "$TMP", "shell": "T=$(pwd)/gw; rm -rf \"$T\"; mkdir -p \"$T/fakeroot/.github/agents\" \"$T/fakeroot/.agents/agents\"; cp -r \"$REPO/conductor/tracks/verify_runner_parity_20260904/verify\" \"$T/verify\"; export HARNESS_ROOT=\"$T/fakeroot\"; cd \"$T/verify\"; echo '--- leg1 baseline-red ---'; ./harness.sh --check acc-1 || true; ./harness.sh --check acc-2 || true; echo '--- leg2 green ---'; cp \"$REPO/.github/agents/orchestra-verify-runner.agent.md\" \"$T/fakeroot/.github/agents/\"; cp \"$REPO/.agents/agents/orchestra-verify-runner.md\" \"$T/fakeroot/.agents/agents/\"; ./harness.sh --check acc-1; ./harness.sh --check acc-2; echo '--- leg3 mutant-red ---'; printf 'MUTANT\\n' > \"$T/fakeroot/.agents/agents/orchestra-verify-runner.md\"; ./harness.sh --check acc-2 || true; echo '--- leg4 restore-green ---'; cp \"$REPO/.agents/agents/orchestra-verify-runner.md\" \"$T/fakeroot/.agents/agents/\"; ./harness.sh --check acc-2; echo '--- leg5 report-bound ---'; DH=$(cat contract.json harness.sh traceability.md | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); echo \"WALK | author=agent | source=trial:walk | RED-DEMO hash=$DH result=fail checks=acc-2\" >> approvals.log; ./harness.sh --report", "timeout_s": 120}
name: E2E Verify: Gate Walk
